title: [Event Request] codeunit 367 "CheckManagement": add OnFinancialVoidCh…
summary: Adds an `IsHandled` event to CheckManagement codeunit that allows partners to replace the balance-account posting logic in financial void check operations.
key_points: New event `OnFinancialVoidCheckOnBeforePostBalanceAccount` enables extension of void check financial posting
Balance-account posting logic extracted into a new local procedure for cleaner code structure
Default behavior preserved when event is unsubscribed
Supports partners implementing custom void check scenarios
Affects all localization layers (W1, APAC, NA, RU)
